scoring_justification: CSSC dihedral recomputed from agent's raw XYZ (T1 structural); orbital energies and compositions validated by comparison to paper‑reported reference values (T0 reference_match) because full extended Hückel recompute is infeasible in the verifier environment.

hidden_assets.purpose: CSSC dihedral reference (90° ±5°), NO₂‑DPDS LUMO energy (−10.5 eV ±0.5 eV), H‑DPDS HOMO sulfur composition threshold (>50%), and composition sum tolerance (0.01).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Section 3.2 reports the dihedral of 90°; Section 3.3 reports the LUMO of NO₂‑DPDS at −10.5 eV and states that the HOMO of H‑DPDS consists mainly of the two sulfur lone pairs.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper’s descriptive text and figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper‑reported values used for comparison; no alternate fabricated data were introduced.

schema.format_description: Standard multi-molecule XYZ format: comment line per molecule (can include substructure name), followed by atom lines with element symbol and x, y, z coordinates.

outputs.description: Optimized atomic coordinates for all six molecules. The checker recomputes the CSSC dihedral angle for each and verifies it is within 5° of 90°, scoring the structural property.

schema.structure: Each key maps to an object with 'HOMO_energy' (float, eV), 'LUMO_energy' (float, eV), 'HOMO_composition' (dict mapping atom label to float), and 'LUMO_composition' (dict). Compositions should sum to 1.0 within tolerance.

outputs.description: HOMO and LUMO energies (eV) and atom-wise compositions for H-DPDS and NO2-DPDS. The checker compares the LUMO energy of NO2-DPDS to the paper value (±0.5 eV tolerance), verifies that the HOMO of H-DPDS is dominated by sulfur lone pairs (S contribution > 50%), and checks the overall composition thresholds.

output_contract.notes: Only the dry-lab computational sub-result is included; wet-lab catalytic experiments are excluded. The agent must perform geometry optimization and EH calculation using public tools or a self-implemented EH solver. The key output dihedral angle and frontier orbital energies/compositions are checked against the paper's reported values with appropriate tolerances. The task is compute-driven with no external data fetching beyond the bundled parameter file.

steps.description: Compute CSSC dihedral angle for each molecule and verify it is within 5° of 90°.
Check that H-DPDS HOMO is dominated by S lone pairs (>50% S contribution), NO2-DPDS LUMO energy is near −10.5 eV (±0.5 eV), and compositions sum to 1.0 within 0.01.
